description: This Java class implements an Elasticsearch sink for audit logs in the Thingsboard platform. It manages connection setup, log message formatting, and asynchronous request handling to Elasticsearch.

classes.name: ElasticsearchAuditLogSink
classes.description: A component that sends audit logs to Elasticsearch, handling connection setup, log formatting, and asynchronous request execution.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Elasticsearch REST client and thread executor, configuring credentials if provided.

methods.name: logAction
methods.description: Schedules an audit log entry to be sent asynchronously to Elasticsearch.

methods.name: doLogAction
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP request with the audit log data to Elasticsearch.

methods.name: createElasticJsonRecord
methods.description: Builds a JSON document from an AuditLog object for Elasticsearch indexing.

methods.name: responseListener
methods.description: Handles success or failure responses from Elasticsearch requests.

methods.name: getIndexName
methods.description: Generates the Elasticsearch index name based on pattern, tenant ID, and date.
